title: Customs clearance records
definition: The entry, declaration and clearance documentation for goods entering or leaving the country, showing the declared description, value, quantity and origin. They are requested where the value of a trade has to be tested against the value declared to a customs authority, which is a comparison the customer does not control.
evidence_to_cite: the entry and declaration, with the entry number and date
the declared value, description and quantity, against the commercial documents
the ports of entry and exit, against the shipping documents

sources.citation: Customs documentation in the assessment of trade-based activity, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
